intro: Your plans. Your pace. One set at a time.
continueText: Pick up exactly where you left off.
emptyHistory: Your story starts with your first workout.
chooseDayText: Pick the session that fits today.
emptyDay: Build this workout by adding your first exercise.
altHelp: Select alternatives from your exercise library. You can add more exercises to any plan first.
confirmRemove: Remove this item from the plan?
finishText: Completed sets are saved to your history. Unfinished sets will be recorded as skipped.
confirmDiscard: Discard this workout and its recorded sets?
altText: Your plan stays the same. Completed sets keep their original exercise and results.
noAlt: No alternatives linked yet. Add them in the plan editor.
saveError: Could not save. Keep this page open and export a backup in Settings.
storageError: Your saved data could not be loaded. Reload to retry; no data has been replaced.
historyIntro: Look back at the work you put in.
storageText: Your data is saved on this device first and synced to your Microsoft account’s OneDrive app folder when connected. Keep a backup before clearing browser data. A workout in progress stays on this device until you finish it.
importText: Import replaces the plans and history on this device. Export your current data first.
confirmImport: Replace all data on this device with this backup?
invalidBackup: This file is not a valid Fitness App backup.
languageHelp: More languages can be added. Your exercise names and notes stay as you entered them.
installText: On iPhone: open this app in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android: use Install app in your browser menu. Open once online to make the app available offline. YouTube videos still need internet.
aboutText: Microsoft sign-in and OneDrive sync. TV casting is planned for a later version.
validation: Check the values: use positive sets and reps, non-negative weight and rest, and a maximum no lower than the minimum.
invalidVideo: Use an HTTPS YouTube or youtu.be video URL.
newPlanHelp: Name your plan, then add workouts such as Push, Pull and Legs.
noHistorySets: No completed sets in this workout.
progressHelp: Completed sets across your saved workouts.
noProgress: Complete a workout to see your exercise history.
confirmDeletePlan: Delete this plan? Saved workout history will be kept.
planInUse: Finish or discard the active workout before deleting its plan.
pplNote: An empty template. Add your own Push, Pull and Legs exercises.
sourceNote: Based on your uploaded 4-day Upper/Lower plan. Weights are entered during training.
nothingToTrain: Add at least one exercise before starting this workout.
alreadyActive: Resume or finish your active workout first.
weightHelp: Set the convention you use consistently; dumbbell values can be per dumbbell. Assistance is logged separately from added load.
libraryHelp: Create exercises here, then add them to workouts or select them as alternatives.
updateReady: An app update is ready. Close all app tabs and reopen after finishing your workout.
timerNote: Keep the app open for the timer sound. When you return, the remaining time is recalculated.
soundHelp: A short sound plays at the end of rest while the app is open. Sound may be unavailable when the screen is locked.
loadError: Could not load the app. Please reload while online.
newVersionAvailable: A new version is ready. Your workout will be saved before reloading.
updateChecked: Update checked. If a new version is downloading, a reload button will appear shortly.
updateNeedsInternet: Connect to the internet to check for updates.
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Please try again later.
signInIntro: Sign in with your personal Microsoft account to sync workout plans and history between your phone and computer.
rememberSignIn: Choose “Stay signed in” when Microsoft offers it. This app remembers your session, never your password. Microsoft may occasionally ask you to sign in again.
signInFailed: Microsoft sign-in could not be completed. Try again while connected to the internet.
signInOffline: Connect to the internet to sign in. Once signed in, your saved training data can be used offline.
signInExistingData: Your existing device data is kept. You can export a backup here before signing in.
differentAccount: This device has data linked to a different Microsoft account. Sign out and choose the original account. This data will not be uploaded to the other account.
syncHelp: Plans, exercises, video links and completed workouts sync through your OneDrive app folder. Editing on different devices may require choosing a version. Finish the workout on this device before syncing it. Microsoft may occasionally ask you to reconnect.
syncRecoveryHelp: Export one of the last three local versions from before incoming changes. Earlier cloud revisions are also retained in the OneDrive app folder and can be restored through Import backup.
syncOffline: Offline · changes saved on this device
syncAfterWorkout: This workout will sync after you finish it.
syncFailed: Could not sync. Your changes are kept on this device. Try again.
syncNeedsLogin: Reconnect Microsoft to continue syncing. Local training remains available.
syncPermissionError: OneDrive access was denied. Reconnect Microsoft and allow access to the app folder.
syncThrottled: OneDrive is busy. Wait a moment, then try syncing again.
syncInvalidData: A OneDrive snapshot is invalid or incompatible. Your local data has not been replaced.
syncTooLarge: The sync file is too large. Export a backup before continuing.
syncTooManyFiles: There are too many app files to sync. Your local data has been kept.
syncConflictTitle: Changes on more than one device
syncConflictHelp: These items were changed independently. Choose the version to keep for each item. Other changes and new workouts are merged. Previous device revisions remain in OneDrive for recovery.
anotherTabHelp: Close the other Fitness App tab or window, then reload this one. This prevents two tabs overwriting changes on this device.
noRecoveryYet: A recovery backup will appear here when incoming data changes this device.
